thread.title: Lightning Round segment Crame

author: SA Editor Mohit Manghnani
title: Lightning Round segment Crame
text:
Lightning Round segment   Program, Wednesday, December 13. 
Bullish Calls KEMET Corp. (NYSE: KEM ): There is no catalyst to go up but it's a cheap stock.
Applied Materials (NASDAQ: AMAT ): It's a good stock. Cramer's trust doesn't own it as they have other semiconductor stocks already.
Bearish Calls Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE ): It's a dicey stock. Cramer prefers Finisar (NASDAQ: FNSR ) after Apple's (NASDAQ: AAPL ) $390M investment .
Snap (NYSE: SNAP ): Cramer is not a fan.
Okta (NASDAQ: OKTA ): No. Cramer would be in VMware (NYSE: VMW ) instead.
Teva Pharmaceutical Industries (NYSE: TEVA ): "I don't want you to touch it. I'd rather you have Teva sandals than Teva Pharmaceutical."
